resolution: Confirmed the user's reading of the pine inspection confusion: each conifer branch is ONE near-horizontal quad wound to face up (verified in flora_geometry.zig addConifer -> addUnculledQuad); the game's frond pipeline draws it from both sides (cull off) so the player under a tree sees it, while the studio stage renders through the back-face-culling mesh pipeline and deletes exactly those from-below pixels. The mesh on disk is identical to the in-world mesh; the studio viewer is the misleading party. Proposed fix (not yet built, awaiting the user's word): render foliage-style packages with culling off in the stage, keyed off the manifests' semanticKind 'flora' or via a general double-sided viewer toggle; recommended AGAINST baking fake back faces into the exported packages since that would falsify the very meshes the export exists to show.
